pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit a sub-polygonal to rounded geometry with soft pixel gradients at the edges. Individual regions are densely packed with relatively uniform spatial area distribution.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interstices form a continuous lattice of light-colored pathways with narrow pixel thickness. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent and tetravalent across the visible surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a jagged 1D silhouette with a high frequency of low-amplitude serrations composed of dark, upright filamentous textures.
